headline: President Obama created a federal task force to coordinate how government agencies investigate and prosecute financial fraud.
what_it_does: This executive order set up the Financial Fraud Enforcement Task Force. Based on its title, the task force brings together federal agencies to work jointly on cases of financial fraud. No summary was provided, so details about its members, powers, and duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal law enforcement and regulatory agencies
who_it_affects.how: They are organized into a shared task force to coordinate their work on financial fraud cases.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses suspected of financial fraud
who_it_affects.how: They may face investigations and prosecutions coordinated across multiple federal agencies.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 17, 2009; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
